title: LionBeatsGG — Discord Music Bot

overview.purpose: Discord music bot with Lavalink audio server integration. Slash + prefix commands, persistent control panel, bass boost, lyrics, and a music-guessing quiz game. Exposes a REST API consumed by the Nova web dashboard.
overview.stack: Node.js, discord.js v14.25.1, lavalink-client v2.9.11, dotenv v16.6.1
overview.companion_process: Lavalink.jar (Java audio server) must run alongside the bot
overview.start_script: bot/run-bot.bat (auto-restart wrapper, 5s delay between restarts) + LionBeatsGG/start-all.bat (launches Lavalink then the bot)

env_vars.LAVALINK_PASSWORD: shared password/authorization string with Lavalink server
env_vars.API_PORT: default 3847 — REST API port used by the Nova web dashboard

lavalink_config.youtube_plugin: Direct video/playlist ID support, ISRC fallback search
lavalink_config.lavasrc_spotify: Client ID/secret in application.yml; region US; playlist/album load limit 100 tracks; search chain ISRC -> YouTube fallback

data_files.bot/data/music-panels.json: { guildId: { channelId, messageId } } — persistent control-panel locations
data_files.bot/data/play-history.json: last 1000 play records (title, artist, duration, artwork, requester, timestamp)
data_files.bot/data/music-stats.json: top songs, top requesters, hourly/daily activity, total plays
data_files.bot/data/quiz-songs.json: quiz song database organized by genre: pop, anime, romance, rock, rnb, hiphop, edm

in_memory_state.musicPanels: Map guild -> panel location (loaded at startup)
in_memory_state.activeQuizzes: active quiz games with live scores

slash_commands.name: /play
slash_commands.does: Validates VC membership, creates player if needed, searches YouTube/Spotify via Lavalink, handles single tracks + playlists, updates control panel

slash_commands.name: /quiz
slash_commands.does: Music-guessing game: 30s per round, fuzzy-match answers (title/artist/anime name), Levenshtein tolerance ~20%, scoring 🥇3/🥈2/🥉1, final leaderboard

slash_commands.name: /set-activity
slash_commands.requires: 6-digit passcode modal (146332) — admin only via passcode not role

prefix_commands.name: !skip
prefix_commands.does: Skip current track (must share VC with bot)

prefix_commands.name: !queue
prefix_commands.does: Shows current track + next 10 + remaining count

music_control_panel.create: /lock-channel <channel> — posts persistent embed, intercepts all non-bot messages as song requests, auto-deletes non-command messages after 5s
buttons_row2: 🔊 Volume (100/75/50/25% cycle, scaled to 40% Lavalink max)
music_control_panel.button_rules: All require same-VC as bot + 5s per-user cooldown; ephemeral responses

rest_api.base: http://127.0.0.1:{API_PORT} (default 3847), CORS enabled for dashboard access

endpoints.returns: uptime, active player count, guild count, current track/queue per player
total plays, top 20 songs, top 20 requesters, hourly/daily activity (90-day)
all genres + counts, or ?genre=X for a specific list

endpoints.does: read/update bot settings (activity text/type, volumes, autoDisconnectMinutes, djRoleId)

rest_api.used_by: Nova web dashboard's Music Dashboard (see chapter 07) — dashboard is a stateless proxy to these endpoints

lavalink_events_handled: trackEnd (update panel, start inactivity timer if queue empty)

quiz_game.init: Fetch 50+ candidate songs to survive search failures; search via Lavalink (anime->YouTube first, pop->Spotify first); build answer variations; shuffle order
quiz_game.round_flow: Play 30s, message-collector listens for chat answers, fuzzy match (exact/partial/Levenshtein <=20% edit distance), first 3 correct scorers get points, reveal answer, 3s pause, next round

process_level: uncaughtException — both logged, never crash the process
error_handling.lavalink: node errors don't crash bot; track errors/stuck auto-skip with channel notification

start-all.bat: Starts Lavalink.jar in its own window, waits 5s
Starts bot via run-bot.bat in its own window
stop-all.bat: Kills window titled 'LionBeatsGG Bot*' + any node.exe running index.js
startup_shutdown.run-bot.bat: Infinite loop: run node src/index.js, on any exit wait 5s and restart; Ctrl+C to stop

file_structure: bot/data/*.json (panels, history, stats, settings, quiz songs)

deploy_commands.purpose: Registers slash commands globally (visible in all servers within ~1 hour)
deploy_commands.run_when: Only needs to run once / after adding new commands, not on every bot start
